leadership, owning end-to-end execution for enterprise MarTech, web platform, and AI/GenAI engagements. Acts as single delivery owner across 
concurrent client accounts — leading requirement discovery, converting business and marketing needs into structured execution plans, milestones, 
and delivery roadmaps, and partnering with solution SMEs and domain experts to define the right technical and MarTech solutions. Hands-on

Headless CMS/Contentful), API integrations, system architecture, and the broader MarTech ecosystem — content, SEO, analytics, and digital 
experience platforms. Drives sprint planning, execution tracking, risk management, and dependency resolution with strong delivery governance, and 
leverages AI-assisted tools (ChatGPT, Cursor) and automation to improve delivery efficiency, quality, and speed. Track record includes 95% on-time

Bosch, and HSBC. Engineering foundation from a B.E. in Electrical & Electronics Engineering and a PG Diploma in Industrial Automation.

Program & Delivery Execution: Sprint Planning, Execution Tracking, Dependency Resolution, Delivery Predictability, Backlog Management & Health,

Management, Cross-Functional Resource Coordination & Leadership, Leading Through Influence (No Direct Authority), Client & Engagement 
Ownership, Single-Owner Delivery Model (2–3 Concurrent Engagements), Cross-Functional Product Teams, Resource Planning & Capacity 
Management, Project Schedule Management, Project Deliverables Management, On-Time Launch Management, Cost, Quality & Delivery 
Management, Regional Project Management, Project Governance Approvals
Web, CMS & MarTech: Full-Stack Web Application Development, CMS & MarTech Execution (WordPress, Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Headless 
CMS, Contentful), MarTech Ecosystem (Content, SEO, Analytics, Digital Experience Platforms), Requirement Discovery & Solution Alignment, Solution 
SME Partnership, Technical Feasibility & Scalability Planning
Technical & Systems Fluency: System Architecture, APIs & Service Integration, Frontend/Backend/ML Coordination, Full SDLC (Specs, Code Review, 
CI/CD, Testing/QA, Release, Monitoring), Design Doc / PRD Review
AI & GenAI: Agentic AI, AI Agent Orchestration, RAG, LLM Fine-Tuning (GPT-4, Open-Source), Prompt Engineering, AI-Assisted Engineering & 
Automation-Driven Workflows (ChatGPT, Cursor), Intelligent Document Processing, AI-Based Document/Data Defect & Error Detection, OCR, NLP, 
Computer Vision, Azure OpenAI, LangChain, LlamaIndex, Vector Databases (FAISS, Pinecone, Chroma), ML Pipelines, Python, SQL

Product Development Lifecycle, Product Launch / Launch Readiness, RFQ-to-Release Lifecycle Coordination, Release Management, CI/CD, Customer 
Sign-off & Project Handover
Tools & Platforms: JIRA, Azure DevOps, Confluence, MS Project, ServiceNow, Smartsheet, ZOHO Projects, Trello, MS Excel (Advanced), Tableau, Power 
BI, Microsoft Dynamics 365, Cloud Applications
Program, Governance & Financial: PMO Governance, Program Roadmapping, Portfolio Management, Budget Forecasting, P&L Oversight, EVM, 
Vendor & Partner Management, Executive & Client Stakeholder Communication, KPI/OKR/SLA Reporting, Strategic Planning, Execution Ownership & 
Talent Development, Customer Experience, Service Operations, B2B SaaS

95% On-Time Delivery | 80+ Projects Delivered | 22% Sprint Velocity & Predictability Gain | 41% Data Error Reduction | 97% SLA Adherence | 15% 
Cost Savings
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Technical Program Manager / AI Program Manager March 2026 – Present
CogniQuest AI — Bengaluru, India
	● Own end-to-end delivery for an AI-driven Intelligent Document Processing pod, partnering closely with Engineering and Product on Agentic 
AI orchestration, RAG pipelines, and Azure Form Recognizer — hitting 95% on-time delivery and cutting time-to-market 20%.

	● Act as primary technical and delivery owner for the engagement, leading requirement discovery with stakeholders and converting business 
needs into structured execution plans, milestones, and delivery roadmaps.

	● Managed end-to-end project schedules, cross-functional resources, deliverables, cost, quality, and delivery milestones through stage-gate 
governance, securing leadership sign-off at each phase of the product development lifecycle.

	● Lead cross-functional pod ceremonies (sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, retrospectives) across AI/ML, Backend, and QA in JIRA — leading 
through influence across teams with no direct reporting line — improving sprint velocity 22%, strengthening sprint predictability, and cutting 
backlog 30%.

	● Run a structured cadence of project and stage-gate governance meetings, documenting minutes and maintaining action item/action-rail

intervention 45%.



	● Designed RAG pipelines pairing vector databases (FAISS, Pinecone) with LLMs for context-aware document Q&A, improving retrieval 
accuracy 33%.

	● Ran fine-tuning on domain-specific LLMs, including GPT-4 and open-source models, lifting entity-extraction precision 18% on regulated 
client datasets while maintaining data quality and security standards.

	● Took OCR pipeline accuracy from 84% to 96% and cut data validation errors 41% through business rule and fuzzy-matching frameworks —

	● Owned P&L, budget forecasting, and stakeholder management across multiple enterprise accounts, driving renewals and upsell, and 
maintained risk/issues registers with proactive escalation to leadership.

	● Owned budget tracking and P&L reporting, and led LAN/WAN infrastructure migrations with zero business disruption.
